title: Geçmiş zaman — olumsuz ve soru
canDo: Dün yapmadığım şeyleri söyleyebilir, olanı biteni sorabilirim.

concept.summary: Geçmişte olumsuzluk ve soru için did kullanılır. Geçmişlik did'e geçtiği için asıl fiil yalın hâle döner — ikinci kez geçmiş yapılmaz. be fiili ise kendi başına çalışır: wasn't, weren't.

examples.en: I didn't go to work yesterday.
Did you call her?
He wasn't ready.
We didn't know the address.
Were you at the meeting?

mistakes.wrong: I didn't went there.
mistakes.right: I didn't go there.
mistakes.why: Geçmişlik bir cümlede iki kez gösterilmez.

mistakes.wrong: Did you saw the film?
mistakes.right: Did you see the film?

mistakes.wrong: She didn't was at home.
mistakes.right: She wasn't at home.

title: Sürekli geçmiş — was doing
canDo: Geçmişte bir anda ne yapmakta olduğumu anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: Geçmişte bir noktada sürmekte olan iş için kullanılır. Genellikle araya giren kısa bir olayla birlikte gelir: uzun iş was/were + -ing, kısa olay past simple olur.

table.example: I was reading when he called.
While she was cooking, I set the table.

examples.en: I was watching TV at nine.
They were waiting for the bus.
She was cooking when I arrived.
examples.note: Uzun iş -ing, kısa olay past simple.

examples.en: It was raining all morning.
While we were talking, the lights went out.

mistakes.wrong: I was watch TV.
mistakes.right: I was watching TV.

mistakes.wrong: They was waiting.
mistakes.right: They were waiting.

mistakes.wrong: When he called, I was read.
mistakes.right: When he called, I was reading.

exercises.text: While I ___ , it started to snow.
We ___ for you at the station.

title: will — gelecek
canDo: Gelecekle ilgili tahmin yapabilir, o anda karar verebilirim.

concept.summary: will tahmin, söz verme ve o anda alınan karar için kullanılır. Kip fiil olduğu için özneye göre değişmez ve ardından yalın fiil gelir.

examples.en: I think she will like it.
I'll call you tonight.
He won't be late.
Will you help me with this?
The meeting will start at ten.

mistakes.wrong: She wills come.
mistakes.right: She will come.

mistakes.wrong: I will to help you.
mistakes.right: I will help you.

mistakes.wrong: He will not to be late.
mistakes.right: He won't be late.

exercises.text: She ___ be at the office today.

concept.summary: Önceden verilmiş karar ve plan için kullanılır; will ise o anda verilen karar içindir. Ayrıca gözle görülür bir belirti varsa gelecek be going to ile kurulur: kara bulutlar varsa yağmur yağacaktır.

table.example: We are going to move house.
Look! It is going to rain.
I am not going to wait.
The phone is ringing. I'll get it.

examples.en: I am going to study medicine.
They are going to sell their car.
Look at those clouds! It is going to rain.
She isn't going to come tonight.
Are you going to watch the match?

mistakes.wrong: I going to study medicine.
mistakes.right: I am going to study medicine.

mistakes.wrong: We are going to moving house.
mistakes.right: We are going to move house.

mistakes.wrong: It will rain, look at the clouds.
mistakes.right: It is going to rain, look at the clouds.
mistakes.why: Ortada belirti varsa be going to yeğlenir.

exercises.text: We ___ visit my aunt on Sunday.
He is going to ___ a new job.
She ___ going to take the exam.
I ___ going to be late again.

title: have to, should, need to
canDo: Bir şeyin zorunlu mu yoksa tavsiye mi olduğunu ayırt ederek söyleyebilirim.

concept.summary: have to dışarıdan gelen zorunluluğu (kural, yasa), should tavsiyeyi anlatır. have to gerçek bir fiildir, o yüzden çekilir ve sorusunu do ile kurar; should ise kip fiildir, değişmez.

formula.left: have to / has to + yalın fiil

table.example: I have to work on Saturday.

examples.en: She has to wear a uniform.
You should rest today.
We don't have to hurry.
Do I have to book a table?
examples.note: have to sorusu do ile kurulur.

examples.en: You shouldn't eat so late.

mistakes.wrong: She have to wear a uniform.
mistakes.right: She has to wear a uniform.
mistakes.why: have gerçek fiildir, üçüncü tekilde has olur.

mistakes.wrong: You should to rest.
mistakes.right: You should rest.

mistakes.wrong: Have I to book a table?
mistakes.right: Do I have to book a table?
mistakes.why: Günlük İngilizcede have to sorusu do ile kurulur.

exercises.text: He ___ get up early every day.

title: would like, Can you …?
canDo: Kibarca istekte bulunabilir, sipariş verebilir, yardım isteyebilirim.

concept.summary: would want'ın kibar biçimidir: would like. Rica ederken Can you …? günlük, Could you …? ve Would you …? daha kibardır. Kip fiil oldukları için hepsinden sonra yalın fiil gelir.

formula.right: Can / Could / Would you + yalın fiil?

table.example: I'd like to book a room.

examples.en: I would like a table for two.
Would you like some dessert?
Can you pass me the salt?
Could you speak more slowly, please?
I'd like to change my ticket.

mistakes.wrong: I would like a coffee, please?
mistakes.right: I would like a coffee, please.
mistakes.why: Bu bir istek cümlesi, soru değil.

mistakes.wrong: Can you to help me?
mistakes.right: Can you help me?

mistakes.wrong: I would like go home.
mistakes.right: I would like to go home.
mistakes.why: would like fiil alacaksa to ister.

exercises.text: I ___ like to see the menu.

title: Present perfect — have done
canDo: Hayatımda neler yaptığımı, ne zaman olduğunu söylemeden anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: Geçmişte olmuş ama ne zaman olduğu önemli olmayan işler için kullanılır: deneyim, yeni haber, hâlâ süren durum. Zaman söylenirse (yesterday, in 2019) artık present perfect değil past simple gerekir.

table.example: Have you ever been to Rome?
We have lived here for ten years.

examples.en: I have lost my keys.
examples.note: Sonucu şu anda geçerli: hâlâ bulunamadı.

examples.en: She has visited Japan twice.
They have just arrived.
We have known each other since 2015.
He has worked here for five years.

mistakes.wrong: I have lost my keys yesterday.
mistakes.right: I lost my keys yesterday.
mistakes.why: Belirli geçmiş zaman söylenince past simple gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: She has went to Japan.
mistakes.right: She has gone to Japan.
mistakes.why: Üçüncü hâl gerekir, ikinci hâl değil.

mistakes.wrong: We have known each other for 2015.
mistakes.right: We have known each other since 2015.
mistakes.why: Başlangıç noktasında since, sürede for kullanılır.

title: Edilgen çatı — is made, was built
canDo: İşi kimin yaptığı önemli değilken olayın kendisini anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: Eylemi yapan belli değilse ya da önemli değilse nesne öne alınır. Yapı iki parçalıdır: be fiili zamanı taşır, asıl fiil üçüncü hâlde kalır. Yapan kişi söylenecekse by ile eklenir. Üçüncü hâl ayrıca sıfat gibi de kullanılır: a broken window.

table.example: It was written by a student.

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
The letter was sent yesterday.
These shoes are made in Turkey.
The house was designed by my uncle.
We couldn't use the broken lift.

mistakes.wrong: The bridge was build in 1973.
mistakes.right: The bridge was built in 1973.

mistakes.wrong: English speaks in many countries.
mistakes.right: English is spoken in many countries.
mistakes.why: Özne işi yapmıyorsa etken çatı kullanılamaz.

mistakes.wrong: The letter sent yesterday.
mistakes.right: The letter was sent yesterday.

title: who ve that — kim, hangi
canDo: Bir kişiyi ya da şeyi ayrıntısıyla tarif edebilirim.

concept.summary: İki cümleyi tek cümlede birleştirmenin yolu. İnsanlar için who, şeyler için which, ikisi için de that kullanılabilir. İlgi zamiri kendi cümleciğinde özne yerine geçtiği için ayrıca bir özne konmaz.

table.example: the book which won the prize
the man who lives (he lives değil)

examples.en: I know a woman who speaks five languages.
examples.tr: Beş dil konuşan bir kadın tanıyorum.

examples.en: This is the bus that goes to the airport.
The house which burned down was very old.
She is the teacher who helped me.
I like films that make me think.

mistakes.wrong: I know a woman who she speaks five languages.
mistakes.right: I know a woman who speaks five languages.
mistakes.why: who zaten öznedir, ikinci özne konmaz.

mistakes.wrong: The man which lives here is a doctor.
mistakes.right: The man who lives here is a doctor.

mistakes.wrong: This is the bus who goes to the airport.
mistakes.right: This is the bus that goes to the airport.

exercises.text: The girl ___ won the race is my cousin.
I bought a phone ___ has a good camera.
The email ___ arrived this morning was urgent.
He is the doctor ___ treated my father.
I prefer books ___ have happy endings.

title: more ve the most
topic: Comparatives and superlatives with more / most

concept.summary: A1'de kısa sıfatlara -er ve -est eklemiştik. İki heceden uzun sıfatlarda ek kullanılmaz, önüne more ya da the most gelir. İkisi bir arada kullanılmaz.

examples.en: This hotel is more expensive than the other one.
She is the most talented singer here.
Please drive more carefully.
It was the most difficult exam of the year.
Trains are more comfortable than buses.

mistakes.wrong: This hotel is more cheaper.
mistakes.right: This hotel is cheaper.

mistakes.wrong: She is most talented singer.
mistakes.right: She is the most talented singer.

mistakes.wrong: It is more good than the old one.
mistakes.right: It is better than the old one.

exercises.text: This book is ___ than that one.
That was ___ meal of my life.
My new job is ___ than the old one.

title: much, another, this book
canDo: Miktar belirtebilir, hangi şeyden söz ettiğimi netleştirebilirim.

concept.summary: much sayılamayan isimlerle, many sayılabilirlerle kullanılır ve ikisi de daha çok olumsuz ve soruda geçer. another "bir tane daha" demektir ve tekil isim ister. this/that ismin önüne de gelebilir; tekrardan kaçınmak için isim yerine one ya da ones konur.

table.example: How much time do we have?

examples.en: We don't have much time.
How much sugar do you want?
Can I have another slice?
This film is better than that one.
I like these shoes, not those ones.

mistakes.wrong: How much people came?
mistakes.right: How many people came?

mistakes.wrong: Can I have another slices?
mistakes.right: Can I have another slice?
mistakes.why: another her zaman tekil isim alır.

mistakes.wrong: I like these shoes, not those one.
mistakes.right: I like these shoes, not those ones.

exercises.text: How ___ students are in the class?
I don't like this bag; show me ___ .
These apples are fresh, but ___ are not.

title: if ve as
canDo: Koşul kurabilir, sebep ve zaman bildirebilirim.

concept.summary: if koşul kurar: gerçekleşmesi mümkün bir durumda if'li cümlecik geniş zamanda, ana cümle will ile gelir. as ise "-dığı için" ve "-ken" anlamlarını taşır; hangisi olduğu cümleden anlaşılır.

table.example: If it rains, we will stay home.
We will stay home if it rains.
As it was late, we left.
As I opened the door, the phone rang.

examples.en: If you study, you will pass.
examples.note: if + geniş zaman, ana cümlede will.

examples.en: We will go out if the weather is good.
If I have time, I will call you.
As she was ill, she stayed in bed.
As I was leaving, it started to rain.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, we will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains, we will stay home.

mistakes.wrong: If you will study, you pass.
mistakes.right: If you study, you will pass.

mistakes.wrong: We will go out, if the weather is good.
mistakes.right: We will go out if the weather is good.

exercises.text: If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
If you ask him, he ___ help you.
___ it was raining, we took a taxi.
I will wait ___ you are late.
If I ___ the answer, I will tell you.

concept.summary: Birinin sözünü aktarırken that'li bir cümlecik kurulur. say kime söylendiğini almaz, tell alır: he said that… ama he told me that… Aktarılan cümle geçmişe kayar: is → was, will → would.

table.example: He said that he was tired.
He told me that he was tired.
"I am busy" → He said he was busy.

examples.en: He said that he was busy.
She told me she would be late.
They explained that the shop was closed.
I think you are right.
The teacher said we could leave.

mistakes.wrong: He said me that he was tired.
mistakes.right: He told me that he was tired.

mistakes.wrong: She told that she was busy.
mistakes.right: She said that she was busy.

mistakes.wrong: He said that he is tired yesterday.
mistakes.right: He said that he was tired.
mistakes.why: Aktarımda zaman bir adım geriye kayar.

exercises.text: She ___ me that the meeting was cancelled.
He ___ that he would call later.
"I am tired." → He said he ___ tired.
"I will help." → She said she ___ help.
They explained ___ the train was late.

title: Dolaylı sorular
canDo: Kibarca bilgi isteyebilir, bir şeyi bilip bilmediğimi söyleyebilirim.

concept.summary: Soru bir cümlenin içine girince soru düzeni bozulur: özne ile fiil yer değiştirmez, do da kullanılmaz. Evet-hayır sorusu aktarılırken if ya da whether gerekir. what burada hem soru hem "şey" anlamı taşır.

formula.left: I don't know / Could you tell me

table.example: I don't know where he is.
I wonder if she is coming.
I didn't hear what you said.

examples.en: I don't know where she lives.
Could you tell me when the bank opens?
examples.tr: Bankanın ne zaman açıldığını söyler misiniz?

examples.en: I wonder if he got my message.
She didn't understand what I meant.
Do you know how much it costs?

mistakes.wrong: I don't know where does she live.
mistakes.right: I don't know where she lives.

mistakes.wrong: Could you tell me when is the meeting?
mistakes.right: Could you tell me when the meeting is?

mistakes.wrong: I wonder that he is coming.
mistakes.right: I wonder if he is coming.

exercises.text: Do you know how much this ___ ?

title: make, let, have — birine yaptırmak
canDo: Birinin bir şeyi yapmasını sağladığımı ya da ona izin verdiğimi anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: Bu üç fiilden sonra kişi gelir, sonra fiil to almadan yalın kalır: make him wait. make zorlar, let izin verir, have görevlendirir. Süren bir işi göstermek istersek -ing kullanılır: I saw him waiting.

table.example: I had the mechanic check the car.

examples.en: My parents let me stay out late.
examples.tr: Ailem geç saate kadar dışarıda kalmama izin veriyor.

examples.en: The film made me cry.
I had the plumber fix the tap.
I saw her crossing the street.
Don't keep me waiting.

mistakes.wrong: She made me to wait.
mistakes.right: She made me wait.

mistakes.wrong: They let us to go early.
mistakes.right: They let us go early.

mistakes.wrong: I saw her to cross the street.
mistakes.right: I saw her crossing the street.

exercises.text: I had a friend ___ my computer.
We heard them ___ in the kitchen.

title: Öbek fiillerde nesnenin yeri
canDo: Öbek fiilleri nesneyle birlikte doğru sırada kullanabilirim.

concept.summary: Ayrılabilen öbek fiillerde nesne iki yere de gelebilir: turn the light off ya da turn off the light. Ama nesne zamirse (it, them) araya girmek zorundadır. Yer, zaman ve sebep tarif ederken where, when ve why ilgi zarfı olarak kullanılır.

table.example: turn off the radio / turn the radio off
the town where I grew up

examples.en: Please turn off the television.
Please turn the television off.
It's too loud — turn it off.
This is the house where I was born.
I remember the day when we met.

mistakes.wrong: Turn off it.
mistakes.right: Turn it off.
mistakes.why: Zamir nesne fiille parçacığın arasına girer.

mistakes.wrong: I threw away it.
mistakes.right: I threw it away.

mistakes.wrong: This is the house which I was born.
mistakes.right: This is the house where I was born.

exercises.text: That is the café ___ we first met.
I will never forget the summer ___ we travelled together.
